bull.b: RenovoRx is converting clinical interest into expanding commercial activity, with strong revenue growth, more active treatment centers, and a larger customer funnel. Continued site activation and repeat usage could broaden adoption and support a durable revenue base over the next several quarters.

Gross margins around 84% indicate attractive underlying economics for RenovaCath once commercial scale improves. High contribution margins can provide substantial operating leverage as procedures and center utilization grow, although the benefit depends on controlling operating expenses and reaching sufficient volume.

Completed enrollment in the pivotal TIGeR-PaC trial advances the evidence base for targeted delivery, while more than 900 procedures and repeat orders demonstrate real-world physician use. These milestones can strengthen credibility, support adoption, and expand the platform's commercial potential.

bear.b: Operating expenses remain far above current revenue, leaving RenovoRx deeply unprofitable despite strong gross margins. Sustained losses may continue until commercial volume rises materially, and elevated SG&A could reduce the operating leverage expected from future revenue growth.

bear.t: High cash burn and declining cash
bear.b: Negative operating and free cash flow means the company is not yet self-financing its development and commercial activities. The decline in cash reduces flexibility and increases dependence on achieving rapid revenue growth or obtaining external capital before the projected breakeven period.

bear.t: Breakeven depends on execution and timing
bear.b: The path to breakeven relies on rapid conversion of pipeline and trial sites into recurring commercial usage, while TIGeR-PaC still has remaining events and topline data is expected in H2 2027. Delays could prolong losses and postpone validation of the platform.
